notes.title: The 9th update of Fetish Locator: S&M Studio is live on Patreon!
notes.content: [p][b][i]Hey, friends![/i][/b][/p][p]Since the point when you and Stacy left everything behind to chase your dreams and conquer the world of adult cinema, it’s all been leading to this. This is the moment in the adventure where fantasies become reality, and ideas take form on screen. [/p][p][/p][p]In the [b][url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/135260237"]ninth release of S&M Studio[/url],[/b] you’ll shoot your very first [b]feature-length film[/b] in your own studio—complete with models, sets, and a script that you and your team brought to life together.[/p][p]This is far more than just a technical leap forward. It’s a creative milestone, packed with passion, challenges, and ambition. And with so many juicy behind-the-scenes events, you’ll get to see familiar characters in entirely new ways. [/p][p][/p][p]Working with Stacy, Kanya, and Taisia, you’ll go through every step of production: writing the script, building the sets, designing costumes, and finally shooting your masterpiece. This storyline of making a movie is the heart of the 9th release—and trust us, you won’t want to miss a second of it. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/ca4fd2b21f66fc5c9745c5d6583f03bc2257aff5.png"][/img][/p][p]But the action doesn’t stop on the set. A sudden [b]cyberattack[/b] hits the IT department’s servers—and now the whole team is counting on you and your brilliant tech experts, April and Nari.[/p][p]You’ll need to act fast and work as one to stop the threat and save the project. And after that kind of stress, there’s only one thing left to do… help the girls unwind. [/p][p][/p][p]Let’s start with [b]Claire[/b]. A closed-door office meeting with her quickly turns into something far more personal. Just be sure to be mindful that in the office, you never know who else is watching. [/p][p][/p][p]If you've stuck around through [b]April's [/b]stubbornness, you'll now get to see a new side of her as she tries to balance her work at Orbix and her responsibilities to her bandmates. The code monkey offers you a chance to go for a jog in the park, just be sure to keep up, or you might miss out on the thrilling ending.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/2a2b910dd0957e27dc5e5da5a32655cd1b0db907.png"][/img][/p][p]For fans of [b]Lyssa[/b], we’ve got a double treat in this update. First, you’ll head out on a playful and colorful [b]date at the amusement park[/b] with both Lyssa and Stacy. Then, back at your studio, get ready for a [b]sizzling[/b] [b]photoshoot[/b] with the sexiest lawyer you know.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/563690fc8390de0602ee4156e162e15f4528e2e7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]💥 Here’s what’s waiting for you in this release:[/b][/p][p]— [b]25 new scenes [/b] [/p][p]— [b]3718 new renders [/b] [/p][p]— [b]251 animations[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We want to thank each and every one of you for your patience, support, and love for this project. You’re the reason we keep pushing ourselves to make each update better than the last. [/p][p][/p][p]And just a reminder—[b]S&M Studio now has an official Steam page [/b]so you can wishlist it right not to stay updated.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763690/Fetish_Locator_SM_Studio/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]See you on set! 🎬💋[/b][/p][p][/p]

The code monkey offers you a chance to go for a jog in the park, just be sure to keep up, or you might miss out on the thrilling ending.

For fans of [b]Lyssa[/b], we’ve got a double treat in this update. First, you’ll head out on a playful and colorful [b]date at the amusement park[/b] with both Lyssa and Stacy. Then, back at your studio, get ready for a [b]sizzling[/b] [b]photoshoot[/b] with the sexiest lawyer you know.

notes.title: 🖤Taboo University: Book Two’s second release is live on Patreon!🖤
notes.content:
As always, three factions — three completely different worlds, and once again, each faction brings you a variety of new events.

An abundance of beautiful girls, steamy scenes, and new adventures await — as always!

We’re excited to announce that the [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/book-2-release-2-127605901?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_fan&utm_content=web_share][b]second release of the second book of Taboo University is now available on our official Patreon page[/b][/url]!

Here’s what you’ll find in this update:
[b]
[h3]❤️ The Syndicate. [/h3][/b]
Get ready for a scorching evening in the company of the fiery Zemfira.
Together, you’ll head to a strip club, where she will take the spotlight with her bold, provocative dances and playful glances, completely capturing your attention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/f582638fd046bbae7e0d86f0d130fd7c7e980139.gif[/img]

And if you're craving even more dancing and pleasure, you’ll find it with the hot and eager trio: Nirmala, Q, and Sabrina. They will draw you into an atmosphere of tenderness, deep relaxation, and pure bliss.

[h3][b]🖤 The Cult. [/b][/h3]

This release is filled with sacred rituals.
One of them takes place under the shroud of secrecy in a hidden location, drawing you closer to the girls of the Cult. You'll take part in a mesmerizing ceremony, with the sensual Irene by your side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/415c1bee21934d48d0e3c21d5bbc905ee5224423.png[/img]

Later, Lumi will invite you to witness an intimate moment — the creation of her new tattoo. You'll become part of a quieter yet deeply personal ritual, a symbolic act of loyalty and connection to the Cult.
This process is filled with both pain and beauty — and it’s up to you to help Lumi turn the pain into something much more pleasurable.
And maybe, just maybe, you'll find yourself drawn to the mysterious tattoo artist, Nia.

[h3][b]👑 The Winners.[/b][/h3]

Transformation and loss of control await you.
Silvia, shining in her new look, will quickly turn what starts as an innocent makeover into an unstoppable, passion-filled party, with the stylist Iona swept up in the heat of the moment. Get ready — this wave of desire will be hard to contain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/3a370477084b31b24ad8da29a505dd2c7c526ec7.gif[/img]

And your relationship with the seemingly untouchable Brigitta will grow dangerously close. Confined spaces will do their work, pushing the tension to the breaking point.
Here, there will be no room left for hesitation or restraint — only raw, overwhelming passion.

[b]This release includes:
🔥 16 new scenes
🔥 2291 new renders
🔥 279 animations[/b]

[i]Each scene is a deeper step into the heart of the story.
Each heroine brings a new challenge for your emotions.[/i]

⚡[b] You can download the new release on our official Patreon page:
👉 [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/book-2-release-2-127605901?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_fan&utm_content=web_share]Click here to access the release[/url][/b]

[b][i]❗ PS: The second book will be available on Steam only after it’s fully completed.
We are working on it non-stop — and trust us, the hottest parts are still ahead. ❗
[/i][/b]
🔥 We sincerely thank you for your patience and support while waiting for this release.
Your belief in the project inspires us to move forward and make each chapter even brighter and more emotional.

Thank you for staying with us!
Your Taboo University Team 🖤

notes.title: 🎉 BIG FRESH UPDATE "Taboo University" Book 2 is here! 🎉
notes.content:
The first book may have ended not too long ago, but the story is far from over. We’re thrilled to present the continuation, promising to be even more intense, captivating, and unpredictable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/c1b2e84757a1cc4fb5d7fe645f9966d82bc8be01.png[/img]

[b]✨ What awaits you in the new chapter?[/b]
Your choices from the first book continue to shape the events, opening (or closing) doors to unique content for each of the three factions.

[b]🔮 The Cult.[/b] Get ready for mysticism and secrets. This chapter introduces the Rite of Initiation, deepening your connection to the secret society. But remember: every decision carries weight, and one wrong move could change everything.

💥[b] The Syndicate.[/b] Chaos is just beginning: underground fights, street brawls, shady deals. The plot thickens, tension rises, and you’ll need all your wits to stay in the game.
[b]
✨ The Winners.[/b] Intrigue and conspiracies won’t let you rest. After the party, the story picks up with new twists: shocking revelations, a bold sabotage plan, and new allies (or enemies). Watch every move of those around you—nothing happens by chance here.

[i][b]🔥 What’s new in the update?[/i]

— 14 new scenes to keep you on edge
— 2,095 detailed renders bringing the story to life
— 171 animations making every moment unforgettable[/b]

💖 Why should you return?
"Taboo University" isn’t just a game. It’s your unique journey, shaped by your choices.

🎮 [b]The link to the release is waiting for you on our Patreon page: [/b][i][b] [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/first-chapter-of-119453091]https://www.patreon.com/posts/first-chapter-of-119453091[/url][/b][/i]

Thank you for your support. Every piece of feedback inspires us to create new chapters and content.

[i]P.S. Once the second book is complete, it will be available on Steam! Stay tuned to catch the release and fully immerse yourself in the world we’re crafting for you.[/i]

Enjoy! 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/50e418b2552e7912a6122cf33ff3a2871d84ee79.png[/img]

notes.title: FRESH UPDATE!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We are thrilled to unveil the most colossal update in the history of Taboo University! 

🚀 Major Highlights:

This update is not just big – it's monumental, surpassing any we've ever crafted for all our ViNovella games. Brace yourselves for an update that goes beyond the ordinary, not just in terms of renders, dialogues, and animations, but in the scale of[b] EPIC events[/b]!

Step into the heart of action! Get ready for confrontations between factions and witness or participate in the mysterious rituals of enigmatic organizations. Take part in intense university competitions that add a competitive edge to the gameplay.

The quality of renders and animations has reached unprecedented heights – prepare to be awestruck!

[b]Current update features:[/b]

[b][list]
[*] 4465 renders
[*] 385 of the spiciest, high-quality animations
[*] An abundance of tantalizing descriptions and exhilarating sounds
[/list]
[/b]
[b]The events are getting more intriguing, the competition fiercer, and the characters hotter! [/b]We can't wait for you to dive into the world of Taboo University!

🎮 See you in the game!

🚨 Important Note:
As of now, the game is exclusively accessible on our official [url=https://www.patreon.com/VinovellaGames]Patreon[/url] page.


[i][b]As soon as the first book is fully completed, it will be available on Steam! Stay tuned for the exciting release and immerse yourself in the captivating world we've crafted for you. 📚✨
[/b][/i]
[b]We appreciate the support!

Thank you![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/f88c385c47e114f97f5bd1132fd238b4252b74b5.png[/img]

notes.title: New Release for Early Access Supporters! (v0.4.16)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We still have [b]a lot to do[/b] in order to prepare ViNovella University for a release on Steam, we want to keep everybody updated on the game's progress and additions as the development continues!

While these releases and updates are for early-access supporters, all the additions and updates that we make during the early-access development will contribute to the release of the game on Steam in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/cc2a5658066215a1984f7215b8e598c878da591c.png[/img]

Today, we just released [b]a big update[/b] that includes [u]Chapter 7[/u]! The game is currently available for [url=https://www.patreon.com/VinovellaGames]early access here[/url].

v0.4.16 Change Log:

[list]
[*] 4006 New Renders
[*] 220 New Animations
[*] 38 New Scenes
[*] 3 New Investigations Chapters
[*] Lots of new characters and locations!
[*] New banging soundtracks
[/list]
We appreciate the support! 

Thank you!
